Which shortwave stations broadcast aimed at Asia?

In the A-26 schedule, 96 stations broadcast aimed at Asia. The most heavily scheduled include Sound of Hope, China Radio International, CNR1 Jammer/Firedrake, China National Radio 1.

What frequencies are used for shortwave broadcasts aimed at Asia?

The most-used frequencies are 7210, 9730, 9850, 13670, 7310 kHz. Which one is best depends on the time of day, the season and your location.

How can I listen without a shortwave radio?

Use a free WebSDR or KiwiSDR receiver in your browser. Our Listen Online page links to receivers and explains how to tune. Schedules are in UTC, so convert to your local time first.
